Itinerary

Day by day

1Day 1Marrakech · Arrival day

Welcome to Marrakech, the vibrant heart of Morocco, where the city’s rich history, vibrant souks, and stunning architecture await you! Keep your eyes peeled at Menara Airport for the sign with your name or company name. Meet your driver, who will assist you and transfer you to your hotel or riad.

2Day 2Marrakech city tour (guided tour)

Depart from your hotel. Your introduction to Marrakech begins in the Medina — the old quarter of the city. We’ll explore this historically charming area by foot.

In Jemaa El Fna, visit the famous 12th-century Koutoubia Mosque and its influential minaret. Your guide will lead you through the labyrinth of alleys and souks filled with the scent of spices and the sound of artisans at work.

Enjoy fresh orange juice, and discover shops selling Berber carpets, silver jewelry, handmade shoes, and leather goods. Then drive to the Lower Medina to explore El Mansour Mosque, the Saadian Tombs, and the ruined 16th-century El Badii Palace. Visit the Mellah and Jewish Quarter.

After a traditional three-course lunch, continue to Bahia Palace — a 19th-century masterpiece of Moroccan architecture built for Si Moussa, a former slave who rose to power. Then visit the Dar Si Said Museum and Tiskiwin Museum, showcasing Moroccan art and craftsmanship.

In the evening, attend the Chez Ali Fantasia dinner and music show. Return to your riad for the night.

3Day 3Majorelle Garden · Anima Garden

This morning, visit the famous Majorelle Garden — a peaceful haven filled with over 300 plant species, small canals, and a tranquil pool surrounded by vibrant blue walls. Explore the Berber Museum to learn about Morocco’s indigenous heritage.

Next, drive 45 minutes to Anima Garden, created by Austrian artist André Heller — a magical three-hectare garden filled with art installations, sculptures, and views of the snow-capped Atlas Mountains. Return to Marrakech in the afternoon and enjoy free time.

In the evening, relax with a Moroccan Hammam Spa experience.

4Day 4Day trip to Essaouira

Start your day trip with a scenic drive to the charming coastal town of Essaouira. Explore the medina — a UNESCO World Heritage Site — with its narrow alleys, artisan shops, and fortified ramparts.

Visit the Skala de la Ville and enjoy panoramic ocean views. Walk through the fishing port to watch blue boats and fishermen at work, then savor fresh seafood at a local restaurant.

Along the way, you’ll stop at argan tree fields to see goats climbing branches and visit a women’s cooperative producing argan oil for both culinary and cosmetic use.

Upon arrival in Essaouira, enjoy free time on the beach and wander along the seafront promenade. Later in the afternoon, return to Marrakech, admiring the scenic sunset views on the way.

5Day 5Cooking classes

Get ready for an unforgettable Moroccan culinary experience! Learn to prepare authentic dishes under the guidance of an expert chef.

You’ll discover the traditional use of herbs and spices, then cook three types of tagines, couscous, three Moroccan salads, two surprise desserts, and refreshing organic juices. End the session by enjoying the meal you’ve prepared — a true taste of Moroccan hospitality.

6Day 6Day trip to Ourika Valley

Depart from your hotel at 9:00 am for a scenic drive along the Ourika River, passing through lush green valleys and Berber villages.

Meet your local guide and enjoy a trek to the stunning waterfalls of Setti Fatma. Relax by the river and enjoy lunch in a traditional restaurant surrounded by nature.

As the day ends, return to Marrakech with hearts full of the valley’s beauty and tranquility.
